label: MODEL_BASED_SENSITIVITY (derived after the frozen summary; not part of the confirmatory analysis)
model: the 32 test articles are treated as independent, identically distributed draws of a Bernoulli discordance indicator (LN and decoder any-hit disagree). This assumption is not verified: articles are a fixed seeded order of WikiText-103 test articles, 28 of 32 were edit sites in the REAL-01R internal pilot, and one prompt per article was used. The bounds below are a sensitivity statement under that model, not a population estimate.

primary_pair.relation: |E[hit_a - hit_b]| <= Pr(discordance) under the same model; the bound constrains the discordance probability, it is not an observed difference

diffmean_vs_no_edit.note: three discordant articles, net +1; descriptive (secondary comparison)

bootstrap_note: the document-bootstrap interval of the primary mean difference is [0, 0] because every observed per-article difference is 0; a degenerate interval is not evidence of equivalence
